{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the first occurrence
trial_df = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline with NaN
trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA, inplace=True)

# Compute response rate by site, stratified by severity to ensure comparability
response_rate_by_site_severity = trial_df.groupby(['site', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute overall response rate by site (unadjusted)
response_rate_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Display stratified response rates
print("Stratified response rates by site and severity:\n", response_rate_by_site_severity)

# Check if the site-level response rates are consistent across severity levels
print("\nOverall response rates by site:\n", response_rate_by_site)"}
